name: Kedar Natarajan
tagline: Dr. Natarajan is a Computational Biologist investigating the fundamental principles of cellular decision-making and tissue organization through the lens of stem cell biology.
bio: Dr. Natarajan is a Computational Biologist investigating the fundamental principles of cellular decision-making and tissue organization through the lens of stem cell biology.
The research group integrates single-cell multi-omics and spatial transcriptomics to map the regulatory landscapes governing cell fate and lineage commitment.
By developing novel computational frameworks, the lab aims to decode how transcriptional regulation and molecular crosstalk define cellular identity and function within complex tissue environments.
